root_cause.text: The `nci_close_device` function fails to complete pending data exchanges when closing an NCI device, preventing the release of socket references held by the data exchange callback.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds checks for the `NCI_DATA_EXCHANGE` flag in `nci_close_device()` and invokes `nci_data_exchange_complete()` with `-ENODEV` to clean up pending transactions, resolving a socket leak described in the commit message.

intent_record.intent_summary: Complete active NCI data exchange with an error during device close to prevent hangs.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check for the NCI_DATA_EXCHANGE flag in nci_close_device, invoking nci_data_exchange_complete with -ENODEV if the flag is set.
intent_record.how: This ensures that any ongoing data exchange is properly terminated and cleaned up with an appropriate error status when the NCI device is closed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure proper cleanup of data timers and pending data exchanges when closing an NCI device.
intent_record.what: Added a synchronous deletion of the data timer and a conditional check to terminate any ongoing data exchange with an -ENODEV error during device closure.
intent_record.how: This ensures that pending timers are stopped and active data exchanges are cleanly aborted when the NCI device is closed, preventing potential resource leaks or race conditions.
